[FACT] User is starting yoga classes at a new studio today.  
[EVENT] User is looking for advice on creating a morning routine to stay energized throughout the day.  
[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/05 (Fri) 15:19.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on starting their yoga journey and provided tips for a morning routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pre-Yoga Morning Routine (60-90 minutes before class) includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hydrate: Drink a full glass of water or herbal tea upon waking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Eat a light, balanced breakfast: Suggestions include fresh fruits with nuts, whole-grain toast with avocado or hummus, overnight oats, or a smoothie bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Get some natural light: Spend a few minutes outside in the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Stretch or meditate: Take 10-15 minutes for light stretching or meditation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for an energizing morning routine include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Establish a consistent wake-up time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Get enough sleep (7-9 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Avoid heavy meals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Limit caffeine and sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Plan your outfit and gear the night before.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Post-Yoga Routine includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stretch and cool down after class.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Refuel with a balanced snack (e.g., smoothie with Greek yogurt, banana, and almond butter).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Hydrate again after class.
